body:
incident-bot: [PAGER] INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx & 429 across API gateways in us-west-2 and eu-central-1. Alert threshold tripped: 5xx rate > 3% for 5m. Paging oncall now.

sarah: acked. seeing a bunch of 502/504 and 429s in the dashboard. customers reporting slow LLM responses. attaching top error: `gateway timeout while fetching model kv-cache`

mike: I can join. initial hypothesis: rate limiter misapplied to internal model-serving path, throttling backbone requests and creating backpressure -> 5xx cascade.

sarah: confirmed spike at 13:02 UTC. logs show thousands of 429s from rl-router to model-pool (10.4.2.*). here's a sample line:
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T13:03:11Z rl-router request_id=abc123 upstream_status=429 upstream_host=10.4.2.47 route=/v1/generate tenant=acme-corp tokens=342
```

trina: paging infra. I'm on VPN, hitting the control plane. I see a recent config roll that changed `global_quota_bucket` to strict mode at 12:50 UTC. rolling back that change might relieve the pressure. who owns the rollout?

mike: that rollout came from infra-autodeploy job `rl-quota-enforce` (pipeline #783). It flipped enforcement from soft->hard for global bucket. we should flip it back to soft immediately.

sarah: agree. mitigation plan: 1) disable strict enforcement (feature flag) 2) enable fallback routing to regional caches 3) scale out model-pool if needed 4) notify customers. who's doing each?

trina: I'll toggle the flag and verify. recommend doing via the control-plane API to avoid a full deploy. command I plan: `curl -X POST "$CP_API/featureflags/rl.enforce_global_bucket" -d '{"value":"off"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`

mike: will standby. also prepare a quick patch to rate-limiter config to add a small reserve for internal backbone traffic: `reserve: 10%` so we don't starve model fetches.

lia: I'm on comms. drafting a brief for affected customers, will mark severity and known mitigations. need ETA on mitigation before external comms.

ops-pager: paging note: oncall escalation if mitigation not complete by +20m.

trina: done, feature flag toggled at 13:12 UTC. control-plane response: `{"ok":true,"flag":"rl.enforce_global_bucket","value":"off"}`. monitoring logs now.

sarah: after flag toggle, 429s dropped by ~60% within two minutes. 5xx also trending down but a few residual 502s remain.

mike: pushing the reserve patch to the regional config now (dry-run then apply). patch command: `kubectl apply -f regional-rate-reserve.yaml --context=prod-us-west-2` content snippet:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  rate_reserve: "10%"
```

trina: applied to us-west-2 at 13:18 UTC. verifying model-pool health: `curl $POOL/health` returned 200 across nodes.

sarah: 5xx < 0.5% now. throughput normalizing. tie closure to 15m of stable metrics. Lia, should we send a small customer note now?

jordan: I'll own postmortem + customer summary. please capture who executed the flag toggle, who applied config, and exact timestamps. customers impacted list is in the billing-prod query — starting extraction now.

lia: sending a short advisory now: "We observed transient elevated errors between 13:00-13:20 UTC impacting generation latency for a subset of customers in US & EU. Root cause: recent quota enforcement change. Mitigation applied; service normalized. Full postmortem to follow." Sending in 5.

mike: note: there were some queued requests that timed out and generated downstream 502s. we should clear stale gateway queues. running `service-gateway clear-queues --older-than 60s`.

trina: cleared gateway queues in us-west-2 at 13:22 UTC. logs show fewer 502s after clear.

sarah: handoff time. I'm taking a break but will stay reachable. mike to lead remaining checks; trina remains on infra follow-up; jordan/lia continue comms and postmortem. ops-pager: continue monitoring for 2h.

ops-pager: escalations enabled until 15:30 UTC. next check-in at 13:45 UTC.

mike: follow-up action items recorded: - revert strict global quota permanently until tested in staging - add automated canary for quota changes that measures backend 5xx/latency - add a small internal reserve to rate limiter by default - run a capacity test for model-pool with burst patterns - update runbook to include immediate feature-flag toggle instructions.

jordan: noted. I'll open the incident ticket and link this thread. preliminary severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting but mitigated).

lia: customer advisory sent at 13:28 UTC. one customer replied with logs; routing that to support.

sarah: closing notes: root cause = misapplied quota enforcement (hard limit) on control-plane -> throttled internal model fetches -> queued/gateway timeouts -> 502/504 fanout. primary mitigation = feature-flag toggle + rate-reserve + queue clear. follow-ups scheduled. good job team. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: service metrics returned to normal at 13:25 UTC. Please file postmortem within 72h and tag #rl-quota.
